original.statement: The Hubble CLI `--cluster` flag now also shows flows emitted from nodes outside the named cluster (to or from the target cluster); the old behavior can be reproduced with `--node-name foo/`.

decision.reason: [ev-868456a7673f] sits under the "Hubble CLI" section of the 1.17 upgrade notes. It says the `--cluster` flag's behavior changed: it now also shows flows from nodes outside the given cluster that go to or come from it. The flag still exists with the same name and the old result is available through `--node-name foo/`. So this is a cli-flag subject `--cluster` of the hubble component with a behavior-changed change type.
